test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 22 Feb 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Name the scheme that was launched on 8 April 2015, under which a loan of up to ₹50,000 is given under sub-scheme ‘Shishu’; between ₹50,000 to ₹5.0 lakh under sub-scheme ‘Kishore’; and between ₹5.0 lakh to ₹10.0 lakh under sub-scheme ‘Tarun’.

options.text: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana (PMJJBY)

solution:
The correct answer is __**Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana (PMMY)**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana (PMMY)** was launched on 8 April 2015 to provide loans to non-corporate, non-farm small/micro enterprises.
 
• Under PMMY, loans are categorized into three sub-schemes:
 
• **Shishu:** covering loans up to ₹50,000.
 
• **Kishore:** covering loans between ₹50,000 to ₹5.0 lakh.
 
• **Tarun:** covering loans between ₹5.0 lakh to ₹10.0 lakh.
 
• The scheme aims to promote entrepreneurship and increase the availability of credit to small businesses.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The scheme is implemented through partner institutions like banks, non-banking financial companies (NBFCs), and microfinance institutions (MFIs).
 
• It is aimed at providing financial support to small businesses, thereby generating employment opportunities and contributing to the economic growth of the country.
 
• PMMY is part of the government's effort to promote inclusive growth and financial inclusion by extending credit to underserved sections of society.
 
• Borrowers under PMMY do not require any collateral security to avail the loan, making it accessible to a larger number of small entrepreneurs.
